header:
Chess Assist v28.5 - content script (original: extension/assets/tne.js, the part after the
"Chess Assist" banner; the first ~4.8 MB of that bundle is Stockfish.js and Socket.IO 4.7.2)

Readable version generated by my deobfuscation pipeline (tools/). Reference only; not loaded.
All identifiers were named by me during analysis; the originals are 1-3 letter obfuscated names.

PIPELINE (runs inside every lichess / chess.com / chessarena / immortal.game tab):

  startSiteDetection()  every 500 ms: which site? is there a live game board?
        |
  connectToServer()     Socket.IO -> wss://162.248.93.34:45494  (licence + remote kill switch +
        |               DOM selectors). Nothing below runs until the server says so.
        |
  loopLichess() / loopChessCom() / loopChessArena() / loopImmortal()
        |               polled every 25-250 ms: whose turn is it? is a piece being dragged?
        |
  onTurnState(0|1|2|3|4)  0 = my turn, 1 = opponent's turn, 2 = game over, 3 = idle, 4 = puzzle
        |
  read the board from the DOM -> FEN string (piece placement + side to move)
        |
  completeFenAndAnalyse()  adds castling rights, picks engine settings for the chosen
        |                  MODE + ELO, then calls analysePosition()
        |
  analysePosition()     UCI commands to the in-page Stockfish (setoption ..., position fen ..., go depth N)
        |
  engine.onmessage      parses "info ... cp/mate ..." and "bestmove e2e4"
        |
  handleBestMove() -> drawOverlay()  arrow on a <canvas> hidden in a CLOSED shadow root over the board
        |
  (optional) autoplay: dispatchMouse() -> background worker -> CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent

Site code names used throughout (variable `site`):
  "periwinkle" = lichess.org     "marooner" = chess.com
  "frolic"     = chessarena.com  "beached"  = immortal.game

comments.engine:
The whole Stockfish.js engine (asm.js/WebAssembly build by nmrugg, GPL) runs inside the page.
STOCKFISH() returns an object with postMessage(uciCommand) and an onmessage(line) callback.
comments.eloIndex: Index 0..11 into ELO_LEVELS, persisted as chrome.storage key "save_seeker".
comments.ELO_LEVELS:
The "ELO" choices shown in the popup: 525, 800, ... 3550 (steps of 275).
IMPORTANT: they are only LABELS. In ENGINE mode the engine always plays at full skill
(Skill Level 20) and the ELO only chooses the search depth:  depth = eloIndex + 1
(525 -> depth 1, 800 -> depth 2, ... 3550 -> depth 12). See completeFenAndAnalyse().
comments.mode:
Engine mode chosen in the popup (chrome.storage "mode_save"):
  "HUNT" = ENGINE   full-strength Stockfish, depth from the ELO slider
  "HUMN" = HUMAN    8 levels of deliberately weakened play (Skill Level + random error)
  "NURL" = NEURAL   like ENGINE but Contempt 99 (maximally avoids draws)
  "STYK" = STYLE    5 personalities, SCARED (Contempt -100) ... RUTHLESS (Contempt +100)
  "HBRY" = FUSION   reads the OPPONENT's rating from the page and scales strength to it
comments.styleLevel: STYLE mode level "1".. "5" (storage "val_saveyk"): SCARED, DEFENSE, BALANCED, ATTACK, RUTHLESS.
comments.suggestionMode: SUGGESTION MODE: MultiPV 3 -> draws the 3 best moves with fading opacity and lists them in the popup.
comments.advancedSettings:
ADVANCED MODE sliders (storage "eyleb"): [depth 1-15, contempt -100..100, skill 0-20,
skill max error 0-5000, skill probability 1-1000]. These ranges are exactly Stockfish.js's UCI option limits.
comments.EVAL_TERM_LABELS:
Row labels of Stockfish's classical `eval` trace table. The "Total" column of each row is
captured and shown in the popup as an evaluation breakdown (storage "epap_value").
comments.chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener:
SETTINGS BUS. The popup (assets/upo.js) never talks to this script directly: it writes keys to
chrome.storage.local and this listener reacts. See docs/06-popup-and-settings.md for every key.
comments.connectToServer:
LICENCE / CONTROL SERVER (Socket.IO over websocket to a raw IP address).
The extension is inert until this server answers:
  on "connect"   -> emit "jscbsh" [savedToken,"","","a"]    (auto-login)
  on "vcnk"      -> login result: (ok, token, isPremium); then emit "scarab"
                    [siteCode, SCRAPED SITE USERNAME, CURRENT PAGE URL, ...]
  on "firefly"   -> (2, selectors): CSS/tag names used to read lichess/chess.com; sets selectorsReady
  on "erifylf"   -> (1, base64 flag, version): "dg6" = enable, "85b" = disable (remote kill switch),
                    then starts the board loop and shows an update prompt if version changed
  on "resjupl"   -> (3, base64 "tPOl") unlocks premium engine extras
  on "bjiwrji"   -> ("cilo", "WFa") unlocks STYLE mode / threats / hotkeys
  on "gregha"    -> account info for the popup; "islisw" -> URL for the popup to open
Login/register credentials typed in the popup are forwarded through "jscbsh" as well.
comments.startBoardLoop: Kick off the per-site polling loop once the server has enabled the extension.
comments.canAutoMoveNow: True when it is our turn on any supported site and no animation/drag is in progress.
comments.clearOverlay: Remove every drawn canvas (arrow) from the shadow root and reset per-position state.
comments.applyKillSwitch: Remote kill switch: the server sends base64("85b") to disable or base64("dg6") to enable.
comments.setFunMode:
"Fun" / challenge modes (storage "value_lgrd"): instead of the engine's move, highlight every
LEGAL move that matches a pattern. 1 random, 2 knight moves, 3 retreats, 4 advances, 5 queenside,
6 kingside, 7 edge files, 8 diagonal, 9 leap, 10 sacrifice (deepest push), 11 slow (shortest push),
12 opening/development moves. Legal moves come from Stockfish's `d` command.
comments.analysePosition:
THE CORE: configure Stockfish and search one position.
  settings = [Contempt, MultiPV, Skill Level, Skill Level Maximum Error, Skill Level Probability]
  fenString = position, depth = plies to search
Sends:  ucinewgame
        setoption name Contempt value <settings[0]>
        setoption name MultiPV value <settings[1]>
        setoption name Skill Level value <settings[2]>
        setoption name Skill Level Maximum Error value <settings[3]>
        setoption name Skill Level Probability value <settings[4]>
        setoption name Move Overhead value 0
        setoption name Minimum Thinking Time value 0
        setoption name Slow Mover value 10
        position fen <fen>
        go depth <depth>        (or `d` / `eval` when legal moves / eval breakdown are wanted)
comments.setServerSelectors: Store the DOM selectors sent by the server and stop the site-detection interval.
comments.completeFenAndAnalyse:
Finish the FEN (castling rights guessed from the move list, en-passant always "-") and choose
engine settings from the MODE / ELO the user picked. This is where "ELO" becomes engine parameters:

  isOpponentTurn          [66, 1, 20,   0,   1] depth 8   (predict opponent's move)
  SUGGESTION              [33, 3, 20,   0,   1] depth 8   (top 3 moves)
  ADVANCED                user sliders
  ENGINE  (HUNT)          [11, 1, 20,   0,   1] depth eloIndex+1
  HUMAN   (HUMN) level 1  [-99,1,  1, 999,  11] depth 8  ... level 8 [99,1,20,11,999]
  NEURAL  (NURL)          [99, 1, 20, 111, 111] depth eloIndex+1
  STYLE   (STYK) 1..5     [-100..100, 1, 19, 125..25, 25..125] depth 8
  FUSION  (HBRY)          opponent rating <=800 -> skill 1 depth 1 ... >2800 -> skill 12 depth 10
comments.stepEloLevel: ELO arrows in the popup: SUB/ADD step one level (wrapping), MIN/MAX jump to the ends.
comments.toggleHide: HIDE button: stop drawing arrows (analysis keeps running).
comments.setOpponentTurn: When it becomes the opponent's turn, the analysis switches to predicting THEIR best move.
comments.moveToPixels:
Convert a UCI move (e.g. "e2e4" split into chars) into canvas pixel coordinates.
Argument 0 = white at the bottom, 1 = board flipped.
comments.dispatchMouse: Ask the background worker to press ("p") or release ("r") the mouse at page coords (x, y).
comments.createClosedShadowRoot:
Anti-detection: the overlay lives in a CLOSED shadow root attached to a board element, so page
scripts cannot see the canvas through element.shadowRoot or querySelector.
comments.drawOverlay:
Draw the suggestion for the current position: create a <canvas> the size of the board, position it
exactly over the board, draw an arrow (or a square ring), and optionally trigger autoplay.
comments.scheduleAutoMove:
AUTOPLAY: wait a random delay from the chosen speed band, then click from-square and to-square
(and click again 500 ms later for pawn promotion, which selects the queen).
comments.detectPositionChange:
Debounce: when the turn state or FEN changes, clear the overlay and block analysis for 100 ms
(250 ms on lichess) so the board animation can finish.
comments.readChessComBoard:
chess.com: every piece is an element with classes like "piece wp square-52" (white pawn, file 5
rank 2). Build the 8x8 grid from those classes and emit FEN; side to move from the move-list length.
comments.onTurnState:
Central dispatcher called by the site loops. 0 = my move, 1 = opponent's move, 2 = game over,
3 = nothing to do, 4 = puzzle. For 0/1 it reads the board of the current site into `fen`.
comments.publishBestMove: Write the best move and the score ("+1.25" / "MATE IN 3") to storage for the popup.
comments.convertForOrientation: Pick white-at-bottom or flipped coordinates depending on how the site draws the board.
comments.handleBestMove:
Called for every bestmove (and every suggestion line). Redraws when the window, board size or
scroll changed; otherwise converts the move to pixels and calls drawOverlay().
comments.syncFunModeState: Publish which fun modes are possible in this position (so the popup can grey out the others).
comments.engine.onmessage:
STOCKFISH OUTPUT PARSER.
  - eval trace lines        -> evaluation breakdown for the popup
  - "Legal uci moves: ..."  -> (from `d`) legal moves for threats and fun modes
  - "info depth .. multipv .. cp/mate .. pv .." -> suggestion lines / score
  - "bestmove e2e4"         -> handleBestMove()
Every message re-arms the site loop 25 ms later, so analysis runs continuously.
comments.fakeBestmoveLine: Fun modes fabricate a "bestmove <move> cp 0" line so the normal drawing path can be reused.
comments.isMyTurnLichess: lichess: my turn when (number of moves in the move list is even) == (I am white).
comments.isBoardSettledLichess:
lichess: false while a piece animates; true only when the latest move is the active one
(i.e. the user is not browsing back through the game).
comments.isMyTurnChessCom: chess.com: my turn when (number of .node move entries is even) == (board not flipped).
comments.loopImmortal: immortal.game polling loop (same structure as loopLichess).
comments.loopChessArena: chessarena.com polling loop (same structure as loopLichess). Refuses to run above 125% zoom.
comments.loopLichess:
lichess polling loop. Decides the turn state, calls onTurnState(), and after a game ends
optionally clicks "New opponent" / "Rematch" (premium auto-requeue, storage "value_nEw_ar").
comments.loopChessCom:
chess.com polling loop, including puzzles and /play/computer.
Warns once if the board "Animation Type" setting is not default (it breaks board reading).
comments.applyEngineExtrasUnlock: Server flag base64("tPOl") -> enables STYLE/FUSION switching, fun modes, threats, advanced mode.
comments.startSiteDetection:
Every 500 ms: identify the site from the URL and check that a real, playable game board is on the
page (lichess: no analysis/puzzle/spectator/variants; chess.com: no analysis/lessons/variants).
comments.resetForNewPage: Navigation (single-page apps): drop the overlay host and restart detection.
